# Extract country abbreviation from the Cyclist column (format: "Name (COUNTRY_CODE)")
df['Country'] = df['Cyclist'].str.extract(r'\(([A-Z]{3})\)')

# Filter to top 10 ranks (assuming Rank column is numeric)
top_10 = df[df['Rank'] <= 10]

# Count occurrences of each country in the top 10
country_counts = top_10['Country'].value_counts()

# Find the country with the highest count
most_common_country = country_counts.index[0]

answer = most_common_country
